learningGoals: Identify and name basic body parts like hands, feet, and eyes 👀
Learn fun action words like clap, tap, and blink 👏
Enjoy singing and acting out simple nursery rhymes 🎶
Develop body coordination through physical movement and play 🏃‍♂️
teachingTips: Sing the poem together and do the actions with your child to make learning fun 🎤
Point to your own body parts and ask your child to name them out loud 👃
Praise your child when they correctly follow action commands like clap your hands 🌟
Keep the learning playful by matching actions to the rhythm of the poem 🥁

funActivities.title: Simon Says: Body Parts Edition 🗣️
funActivities.description: Play a fun game of Simon Says using actions like touch your nose or blink your eyes to practice body parts. 👃

funActivities.title: Mirror Dance 🪞
funActivities.description: Stand in front of a mirror with your child and do silly actions like tapping your feet or clapping hands for them to copy. 💃

funActivities.title: Rhyme and Freeze 🧊
funActivities.description: Sing the Two Little Hands rhyme while moving around. When the song stops, everyone must freeze like a statue! 🧍‍♂️
